title: Coefficient bias accuracy
statement: Let a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input have dimension $n>0$, accuracy $a/b$ with integers $a>0$ and $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $S\ge1$. Write $\varepsilon=a/b$, let $M=\max\!\left(1,\left\lceil 4S^2/\varepsilon\right\rceil\right)$, and set $\tau=\varepsilon/(4M)$. The coefficient input has accuracy $\varepsilon/(2\lceil 4/\tau^2\rceil)$.
hypotheses_covered: twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is an integer at least one
